results: Safari sends each command with browser and client metadata through request/reply messaging
Native app notifications refresh shared settings without forwarding untrusted notification data
Polling discovers a missed app change and suppresses repeated identical settings
Status acknowledgments do not trigger a state/report feedback loop
An unchanged Safari setting still requests a fresh filtering acknowledgment every twenty seconds
Transport errors invalidate the Safari connection and stop its polling timer
A late native reply after disconnect cannot overwrite a newer connection
Chrome keeps the original native messaging transport and browser identity
scope: Production Safari transport with controlled browser boundary; real Safari integration is separate.
